info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Loyalty Points Expires-v1-spec
info.description: This API provides a comprehensive overview of expiring hotel loyalty points for members. Users can retrieve data on loyalty points that are approaching expiration, enabling timely redemption and improved member engagement. The primary consumers of this API are hotel management systems and mobile applications aimed at enhancing customer loyalty programs. By integrating this information, businesses can proactively notify members about their loyalty points, ensuring higher satisfaction and retention rates.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve information about points that have expired. It provides details on the nature of the expired points, enabling users to understand their account status.

requestBody.description: This request is utilized to specify the details necessary for expiring points within the system. Please ensure that all required fields are populated accurately to facilitate a proper response.
